digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent tickets clone and autodeploy
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume is not refreshed during redeploy because the Docker entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, causing divergent history to persist across deployments.
The entrypoint runs reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT credential block, so convergence must work with REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT unset.
autodeploy.sh omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing script-only changes to the ensure script from triggering autodeploy, requiring manual bootstrap for the first deployment.

The ensure script must fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets to advance the remote-tracking ref that the classifier reads, with graceful degradation (exit success, preserve local tip, warn) if fetch fails due to missing credentials or unreachable origin.

Pre-epoch local clones must adopt newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commits only under strict preconditions: prior remote tip was readable, local tip is ancestor of prior remote, and remote record has valid epoch, using rebar._store.sync.reconverge for all compatible cases and a narrow reset-hard path only for proven-safe pre-epoch-to-epoch transitions.

Store write failures after vote casting must remain best-effort and never undo already-recorded Gerrit votes, preserved by convergence running before the review-bot accepts work and by artifact-emit failure handling.
